limits: Selective font-name retrieval, not proof of identity. Similar or metrically compatible fonts may be indistinguishable. Uncertain names are withheld. Font binaries and per-letter bitmaps are not included.
validation_policy: At least 97% precision among accepted names and at least 95% rejection of the unknown-font calibration examples; maximize accepted names within these bounds. These are empirical development thresholds, not guarantees.
